summary: Ares Core Infrastructure Fund filed an 8-K reporting the unregistered sale of common shares in its monthly closing for June 2026, raising $851.3 million at NAV ($24.9295 per share) across four share classes. The issuance is exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Rule 506(b), and Regulation S. The filing also discloses the May 31, 2026 NAV ($4.1788 billion aggregate) and declares regular monthly distributions for June through September 2026. This is a routine capital-raising and dividend announcement; there is no special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring.
